summary: FASE 3 (Auto-Chat WhatsApp + PDF Invoice configurable wording) tested end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (100%). Frontend: all critical selectors verified (AutoChatConfig, InvoiceConfig, buyer download-invoice-btn).

minor.issue: invoice_texts dict has 16 keys including 'summary_label', but frontend INVOICE_TEXT_FIELDS only exposes 15 (no summary_label). Either expose summary_label in UI or remove it from DEFAULT_STORE_CONFIG to match spec's 15-field list. Non-blocking — extra backend key is harmless.

integration_issues.issue: jsPDF download is triggered via blob URL + a.click() (FileSaver). Playwright headless does NOT reliably fire 'download' event for jsPDF blob downloads, so automated download capture fails. However, button click executes without JS errors, success toast 'Invoice didownload!' is wired (visible in code path) and handleDownloadInvoice catches errors. Manual browser test should confirm PDF downloads. NOT a code bug — Playwright/jsPDF interop limitation.

Fun Facts popup auto-shows after order search, partially overlaying order cards. Not blocking the download-invoice-btn but a UX concern. Already known from prior iterations. Can be suppressed via localStorage.onboarding_done='1' but popup logic reappears after Lacak action.

action_items: (Minor) Decide on invoice_texts.summary_label: either add a UI input field in INVOICE_TEXT_FIELDS or remove the key from DEFAULT_STORE_CONFIG. Spec says 16 keys but lists 15 — backend has 16, frontend has 15.
(Optional) Suppress FunFacts popup on /#/buyer/track route OR auto-close after order search to avoid masking download-invoice-btn.
critical_code_review_comments: render_chat_template covers all 15 documented placeholders correctly (verified — no KeyError/render exceptions on multi-placeholder template).
store-config PUT deep-merge via dot-notation works for nested auto_chat_config.{stage} updates (preserves sibling stages). Verified via test_partial_auto_chat_update_preserves_siblings.
Backfill logic in seed_database for auto_chat_config and invoice_texts is per-key (not whole-dict replace), so missing keys are added without wiping user edits. Good.

WA diagnostic fields _wa_seller_sent/_wa_buyer_sent/_wa_*_reason properly populated on both create_order and update_order_status; reasons differentiate 'disabled' (config flag false) vs Fonnte response failure ('token invalid' etc.). Excellent for debugging.
server.py now 1872 lines (was 1300 in iteration_8) — modularization (routers/) increasingly necessary per >700 line guideline.

AutoChatConfig: when seller_enabled/buyer_enabled toggled OFF, the textarea is hidden (conditional render). This is intentional UX but may confuse users wanting to edit template without enabling. Consider showing textarea always with a 'enabled' indicator badge.
buyer OrderTracking canDownloadInvoice = order.received || isDone — matches spec (selesai OR received=true).
